main.description: Submit a zk-SNARK non-linkability proof for an organism rebirth. Verifies the Groth16 proof against the RebirthVerifier contract on the configured chain (Base L2 default). On success: records vertex_karma_rebirth_proof row with status='verified' and the on-chain tx_hash; the proof is now claimable by a subsequent karma.rebirth XRPC call against the new_did. Phase K3: the verifier currently accepts any well-formed proof input (stub), but the on-chain nullifier burn IS enforced — submitting the same nullifier twice fails.

oldDidHash.description: sha256(oldDid) — committed for audit trail without revealing which old DID. Optional for K3.

newSantanaRoot.description: 32-byte hex (0x-prefixed) — public output of the circuit

nullifier.description: 32-byte hex — public output, prevents double-spend of old organism
